manifest.name: Shopping list
manifest.description: Reads out and ticks off your Home Assistant shopping list with the media controls of your player, such as those of your headphones, while you are in a supermarket zone. Add it once per person, with their own player.

player_id.label: Player
player_id.description: The player whose media controls you use while shopping, usually your phone in the Music Assistant app.

person_entity.label: Person
person_entity.description: The Home Assistant person whose location counts, such as person.alex.

zone_entities.label: Supermarket zones
zone_entities.description: The Home Assistant zones in which shopping mode is on, such as your supermarkets.

switch_entity.label: Switch for shopping mode (optional)
switch_entity.description: A Home Assistant switch, such as input_boolean.shopping_mode. While it is on, shopping mode is on wherever you are: switch it from a widget, by voice or from an automation. The page of the plugin switches it too.

todo_entity.label: Shopping list
todo_entity.description: The Home Assistant to-do list to read, such as todo.shopping_list.

zone_todo.label: Shopping list in {0}
zone_todo.description: The to-do list read in this zone. Leave it empty for the shopping list above.

remove_items.label: Delete entries instead of ticking them off
remove_items.description: Ticking off deletes the entry from the list instead of marking it as completed.

tts_engine.label: Text-to-speech engine
tts_engine.description: The voice that reads the entries. Home Assistant offers each of its text-to-speech entities here, such as Google Translate or Piper.

chime.label: Chime before announcements
chime.description: Play a short chime before each entry is read.

read_on_play_pause.label: Play/pause reads out the current entry
read_on_play_pause.description: Off: play/pause keeps pausing the music in shopping mode.

complete_on_next.label: Next ticks off the current entry
complete_on_next.description: Off: next keeps skipping to the next track in shopping mode.

skip_on_previous.label: Previous moves the current entry to the end
skip_on_previous.description: Off: previous keeps going back a track in shopping mode.
